customActions.label: Wiki neu bauen
customActions.prompt: Read all files in /raw-sources/. Compile a wiki in /wiki/ following the rules in CLAUDE.md. Create an index.md first, then one .md file per major topic. Link related topics using [[topic-name]] format. Summarize every source. Log everything to log.md.

customActions.label: Neue Sources
customActions.prompt: Read all files in /raw-sources/. Compare against the existing wiki in /wiki/ and log.md to identify which files or content are new or changed since the last run. For each new or changed piece: summarize it and integrate it into the appropriate existing topic file in /wiki/, or create a new topic file if none fits. Update index.md if new topics were added. Link related topics using [[topic-name]] format. Append a log entry to log.md for each new source processed — do not overwrite existing log entries.

customActions.label: Thema erweitern
customActions.prompt: Research {input}. Find good sources yourself rather than asking me. Create or expand topic files in /wiki/ covering this, written clearly with code examples where relevant. Link related topics using [[topic-name]] format. Update index.md if new topics are added. Log what was added to log.md. Keep this efficient — avoid excessive tool calls or token usage.

customActions.label: Brain-Suche
customActions.prompt: Search /wiki/ and /raw-sources/ for information relevant to: {input}. If you find a clear answer there, use it and cite which file it came from. Only if nothing relevant is found, search the web for an answer. Keep the answer concise.
